notes.title: 0.60.5 - Crash bang wallop
notes.notes:
The 0.60.x build should improve the stability of the game. 

The main focus of this release is to improve stability by:

1. changing the build process to Godot v4.1.1.
2. update the build to use the production build. 
3. change how scenes transition. 

All these changes should combine into more stability.

There are some other small changes to the game. 

1. When using the menus the farmer's voice has been replaced with a whistle
2. If you look very carefully at the top of the map you'll see a glimpse of the next town... but it's still not accessible yet.

notes.title: 0.59.1 No body puts lamby in a corner
notes.notes:
Today's update changes the sheep's behaviour in a couple of ways.

1. When a sheep is close to another sheep but there's a fence or pen between them they will no longer influence each other. You'll notice this mostly when you're trying to herd sheep around the pen and you have some in the pen and some outside, before today's update the sheep in the pen would move around a lot because of the influence from those outside the pen.

2. Sheep will now turn away from pens and fences, in the same way they do with walls. This makes it easier to get the sheep through gates and also means fewer sheep getting stuck in corners.

Enjoy! And happy herding!

notes.title: 0.58.2 - I can see clearly now the zoom is fixed
notes.notes:
All things being well, if you're a solo player you'll barely notice this update. But if you're playing multiplayer this is an exciting one. 

With v0.58.2 I've updated the camera for multiplayer so it zooms out when you're far away from the other players. Also, if you're playing with three or four players and you're out on your own the camera will ensure it's taking that into account too. Previously the camera took an average of all positions which would mean any rogue players would go off screen.

Let me know how you find this update in the discussions.

notes.title: 0.57.20 Release - a strange case of the disappearing dog
notes.notes:
This release makes two changes:

1. Implements WASD controls across the game. Previously the WASD keys worked when playing the game, but not when navigating menus. That's now fixed.

2. Fixes a bug on the versus games where the dog would disappear through the floor. It was reported as happening on the corn level, but the bug had the potential to affect any PvP sheep-dog trials. 

Enjoy the fixes folks. And be sure to keep letting me know where the bugs lie and I'll keep squashing them.

Keep track of my progress on the Trello board for the game: https://trello.com/b/3aDRDMVn/too-many-sheep-roadmap

notes.title: 0.57.19 Release - Beep Beep I'm a Sheep
notes.notes:
Small update today that adds a horn to the car. 

When you're driving around you can now press the "bark" button and it will beep the car horn. 

Thanks for the suggestion from one of the reviewers :)

notes.title: Added Mac version of the game
notes.notes:
Hi folks, I've added the Mac build of the game for release today. 

I've only for a 2016 Intel Mac to test this one, so if you have something a little beefier, please let me know if it plays like in the trailers. 

My 2016 mac runs the game, albeit quite slowly!

notes.title: Fix for instructions and stability
notes.notes:
Hi folks, I made some minor changes to the game today.

1. The instructions on the title screen appeared off the screen. They should now be visible
2. A change to how the game is built that should help with stability for some folks playing. I had reports of people playing the game whilst using OBS and it crashing occasionally. This build should help.

Enjoy!

notes.notes: To celebrate Too Many Sheep going into early access. Join me, David, and my daughter, as we take on the ten levels together.

notes.title: Too Many Sheep going into Early Access
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44059950/c613029d12dc1bd67a2ecd7b82469fb19119fbbf.png[/img]

Get ready for a baaa-rilliant gaming experience that I'm thrilled to introduce - "Too Many Sheep"! It promises to be an enchanting and exciting challenge for you and your whole family!

Features in Development:
🌟 Control your own customisable Sheep Dog: Embrace the role of a sheepdog as you navigate through thrilling levels, guiding your endearing, woolly companions to safety.

🌟 Varying Difficulty Levels: Challenge your herding skills and strategic thinking at every turn! From beginner-friendly to a sheep-whisperer expert, there's something for everyone.

🌟 Play with Friends and Family: Gather up to four players and embark on an unforgettable co-op challenge! Join forces and work together to conquer the chaos and bring the sheep to their destination.

🌟 Ten Co-op Levels: Enjoy not just a few, but a whole flock of ten co-op levels! Each one offers unique challenges that will keep you engaged for hours on end.

🌟 Four PvP Levels: Compete head-to-head with friends in four intense player-versus-player challenges! Prove who the true sheep whisperer is in thrilling multiplayer showdowns.

🌟 100% Unique 3D Models: Immerse yourself in a charming and visually stunning world, where every sheep and environment is hand-crafted with love and care.

🌟 Family-Friendly Fun: Created with parents and kids in mind, "Too Many Sheep" is the perfect game for wholesome family entertainment. Say goodbye to worries about inappropriate content!

Prepare to embark on a heartwarming journey filled with delightful sheep, joyous moments, and plenty of sheepish challenges! Stay tuned for further updates and release dates.

Let the sheep herding begin this Wednesday! 🌟🐑🌟

notes.title: Too Many Sheep play test now available
notes.notes:
Hi folks, 

I'm super excited to make Too Many Sheep's play test available today. 

In the playtest, you'll find many of the core features of the game:

[list]
[*] Up to four-player co-op
[*] Customisable dogs - the ten-gallon hat is my favourite
[*] Seven levels - primarily based on real-life sheep-dog trials
[/list]

I'll be active within the community area of Too Many Sheep's Steam page, eagerly awaiting your feedback . Whether it be bugs you find, frustrations you feel, features you'd like, or just a note to say you find the game fun. 

Thanks so much for taking the time to support me and my sheep herding game, have a wonderful day 😍
